findings.evidence: One story covers user bust, user winning all chips, and Leave table in a sit-and-go (between hands and mid-hand) in 8 ACs and a want that joins asks with 'and'.
findings.fix: Split Leave table in a sit-and-go (REQ-008.10, AC7-8) from the bust/win end of the sit-and-go (REQ-008.5/.6).

findings.evidence: Description says that without the review panel the session ends after the 1.5 s result delay, but no AC checks the delay or that the result is shown first.
findings.fix: Add AC: Given the user busts with the panel closed, When the result is shown, Then the Session Report opens after 1.5 s and not before.

findings.evidence: AC3 invents a 10 s wait that no requirement states; it expresses 'next hand waits' but with an unsourced value.
findings.fix: Reword: Then no hand is dealt and the Session Report has not opened until See results is chosen.

summary: All 14 E05 clauses covered with exact values (level schedule, header countdown, finishing positions recomputed correctly). No CRITICAL or HIGH findings; only a split suggestion and minor AC polish. C5-AND warnings on E05 are sit-and-go false positives.
